areaButtons.label: Central Ring
areaButtons.summary: Current Bazaar slice: arrival gate, arena, auction house, food row, and prize board.

areaButtons.label: Sky Docks
areaButtons.summary: Future inter-world cargo, smuggler contracts, and rare material exchange.

areaButtons.label: Grand Arena
areaButtons.summary: Future tournament brackets, sponsor drama, and world-reactive combat showcases.

nodes.name: Gate of Scales
nodes.description: A customs gate where coins, memories, and monster trophies are all weighed by the same smiling clerks.

people.label: Ask the scale broker
people.summary: Learn the Bazaar rule: nothing is free, but some prices are friendly until they are not.

ops.title: Bazaar Rules Heard
ops.summary: Bin learned that Bazaar prices can include favors, memories, and future trouble.

ops.title: Scale Broker
ops.text: The broker smiled like a tutorial NPC with a lawyer. Bin decided to read every sign twice.

nodes.name: Lantern Arena
nodes.description: A circular stage for test fights, exhibition matches, and audience betting. The crowd loves style almost as much as victory.

people.label: Talk to arena clerk
people.summary: Register for safe exhibitions before louder arena brackets unlock.

ops.title: Arena Registered
ops.summary: Bin can take test matches in the Lantern Arena.

ops.title: Arena Clerk
ops.text: The clerk called it a safe match, then handed Bin a waiver thick enough to stop an arrow.

nodes.name: Glass Gavel House
nodes.description: A bright auction hall where relics, rumors, and cursed convenience items pass from hand to hand.

actions.label: Read auction board
actions.summary: Preview lots that react to other-world progress.

ops.title: Auction Board
ops.text: One lot wants monster teeth. One wants pre-collapse medicine. One wants a buyer brave enough not to ask questions.

nodes.name: Lantern Food Row
nodes.description: A street of impossible snacks. Some dishes boost morale. Some remember who ate them.

actions.label: Buy safe snack
actions.summary: A small mood beat and a little Bazaar texture.

ops.title: Safe Snack
ops.text: It tasted like grilled chicken, honey, and a very tiny NDA.

nodes.name: Prize Board Annex
nodes.description: Arena prize notes, auction previews, sponsor rumors, and cross-world trade hooks pinned with red string.

actions.label: Check prize board
actions.summary: Find arena, auction, and trade notes that only appear after progress in Earth, Haven, or Zombie world.

ops.title: Prize Board
ops.text: The board has sections labeled Earth, Haven, Last Light, and Debts Nobody Admits Are Theirs.
